title: Maximum Valid Pair Sum
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, find the maximum sum of nums[i] + nums[j] for all valid pairs (i, j) where 0 = k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, find the maximum sum of nums[i] + nums[j] for all valid pairs (i, j) where 0 = k.
constraints: A pair i<j is valid when j-i>=k.
hints: At right index j, eligible left indices end at j-k.
Maintain the maximum value among that growing eligible prefix.
Add nums[j] to the prefix maximum and retain the best pair sum.
Every valid pair is considered when its right endpoint is processed.
editorial: Every valid pair is considered when its right endpoint is processed.

tests.explanation: The pair values five and eight is separated by two indices and sums to thirteen.
Only indices zero and two qualify, giving eleven.
